ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: Figure 11 is a schematic diagram of a mixed agricultural system. The outer dashed frame indicates the system boundary. Inside the frame are parts including “crop farming,” “animal husbandry,” “farm households,” “biogas digester,” “feed processing,” “food processing,” etc., and there are multiple arrows inside indicating circular utilization among crop farming, animal husbandry, and processing links. Arrow ④ is located in the lower right corner of the figure, near the right side of “animal husbandry,” and its direction is from inside the dashed frame to outside the dashed frame. Reasoning: the question only asks what arrow ④ indicates. Since arrow ④ points from inside the system to outside, it is not the internal circular utilization between crop farming and animal husbandry inside the frame, but the commercialized output flow of the mixed agricultural system to the external market. Combined with the outward supply of crop farming, animal husbandry, and processed products in the mixed agriculture shown in the figure, arrow ④ indicates feed, flowers, oil crops, etc. supplied to the market.
